changes_made.explanation: Removed generic 'T5' and kept specific versions (T5-base, T5-large). Simplified output description for consistency. The paper does generate questions as part of the generative passage selection model.
All metrics are correctly extracted and properly normalized. EM (Exact Match), F1, and accuracy are used to evaluate passage selection and QA performance.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. The T5 models are used for generation and passage selection, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations use automatic metrics on benchmark datasets.

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on multi-hop question answering with a novel generative passage selection approach. While question generation is part of the model (p(q|c_ij)), the main evaluation is on QA performance using standard metrics. The NLG component (question generation) is used as an internal mechanism for better passage selection rather than being the primary evaluated output. The extraction was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for model versions.
